project.name: election-public-website
project.productType: Public voting and published election results

must: Reuse the original voting-page shell, circular AMSUL logo, centered ElectionHead, spacing, and mobile header behaviour unchanged.
Use runtime AMSUL primary #b1300b and the original buildTenantTheme function, Georgia headings, and locally loaded DM Sans body text.
Keyboard controls, readable numeric text alongside bars, and mobile layouts.
Anonymous results only for published, unarchived elections in the requested active tenant.
Read backend winner and tie flags unchanged; display one-seat ties as Tied without Elected. Keep Elected plus Tied for multi-seat ties.
Compressed PDF generated once at publication, stored and reused; signed download URL requested only on click.
avoid: Decorative hero gradients, admin navigation, or unrelated visual identity.
Hosted 21st generation without verified AI access.

decisions.decision: Make the full-count disclosure look clickable with a tenant-colored border, white fill, hover state and circular chevron. Its label changes between View full count and Hide full count. Remove the outcome-first subtitle above the results cards.
decisions.source: User requested a clearer results disclosure control and removal of the subtitle.
decisions.scope: Results disclosure appearance and section copy.

decisions.decision: Restore the normal numbered position header with full-width result cards beneath it on all screen sizes. Remove the separate number gutter and its extra page width. Keep the normal-width centered assistance footer.
decisions.source: User requested reverting the gutter after reviewing mobile screens.
decisions.scope: Supersedes the separate results-position gutter decision.

decisions.decision: Keep results assistance centered at its normal 612px column width rather than stretching across the page. Give each position number its own gutter and align the title pill and result card in the adjacent column. Allow additional desktop page width for the gutters so result cards remain spacious; keep two result columns above 900px.
decisions.source: User clarified normal footer proportions and separate position-number gutters.
decisions.scope: Results footer sizing and position-card alignment.

decisions.decision: Use 26px winner names with 18px vote text (16px on mobile), restore result-position number pills, and keep the wide two-column result cards. Fix position-title centering and wrapping in the shared pill layout. Results show only centered Electoral Committee assistance; the main voting page retains its Voting Notice footer.
decisions.source: User supplied an updated screenshot and requested balanced typography, restored position numbers, app-wide position-pill alignment, and assistance-only results footer.
decisions.scope: Supersedes prior results heading, numbering, and footer decisions.

decisions.decision: Result cards fill the same column widths as the Voting Notice footer card. Remove remaining result-position serial numbers so the title pill and card share a left edge without a reserved number gutter. Use shared card__title styles for winner headings and the original voting position-title size. Keep result and footer grids at two columns above 900px and one below.
decisions.source: User requested result cards at least as wide as Voting Notice and consistent heading sizes; earlier requested serial-number removal.
decisions.scope: Results card dimensions, headings and footer alignment.

decisions.decision: Widen the results content area and increase card padding while retaining two result columns above 900px. Reuse one shared VotingPageFooter for the main ballot and results pages, with Voting Notice and the election's Electoral Committee contacts.
decisions.source: User requested bigger result cards and the main voting page footer.
decisions.scope: Public results sizing and shared voting footer.

decisions.decision: Use the shared back link on results, centered on desktop and beneath the election logo on mobile. Align winner cards with the position title pill, inherit ballot avatar sizes for all candidates, and omit candidate serial numbers and the percentage explanation.
decisions.source: User requested results-page corrections with annotated screenshots.
decisions.scope: Public results layout and shared election navigation.

decisions.decision: Use Winners first inside the original public voting shell.
decisions.scope: Accepted and implemented in the public results route and shared backend.

decisions.decision: Follow the current backend tie rule. One-seat ties display Tied only; multi-seat cutoff ties retain Elected plus Tied.
decisions.source: User explicitly selected current backend rule.
decisions.scope: Accepted and implemented in the public results route and shared backend.

decisions.decision: Include an optional compressed public-results PDF in the first release. Generate once per publication, store and reuse it, and transfer it only when the visitor clicks Download.
decisions.source: User explicitly accepted generated-once, compressed, click-to-download report.
constraints: Keep text and vote figures readable and accurate.
Reduce image dimensions and image encoding size; avoid unnecessary embedded assets.
Keep the public results page available if PDF generation fails.
decisions.scope: Accepted and implemented in the public results route and shared backend.

decisions.decision: Implement the accepted results flow in both the dashboard/backend and public voting website.
decisions.source: User explicitly approved work in both projects.

evidence.note: Uses real API data and existing VotePageShell, ElectionHead, PositionHeader, CandidateAvatar and tenant theme.
